memberdef.name: TowerEvaluator

briefdescription.para: DPolyTraverser subclass that evaluates a tower polynomial under a RingMap.

detaileddescription.para: Each viewTerm(coeff, exp) callback translates the exponent vector into a varpower monomial, evaluates map's images of the relevant variables, multiplies them with the coefficient (coerced through K), and folds the result into the SumCollector* H. After traversal, H->getValue() is the evaluated ring_elem in the target ring.
